🎨 ComfyUI 的高级 AI Art Remix 工作流程

通过这种先进的 ComfyUI 工作流程解锁创意可能性的新领域！

📌 概述

这种尖端的 ComfyUI 工作流程允许您重新混合和融合各种艺术风格、控制深度和灯光，并使用最先进的 AI 模型模拟艺术家技术。它将 Flux 模型的强大功能与智能提示生成和广泛的样式库相结合，实现了无与伦比的创意灵活性。无论您是经验丰富的人工智能艺术家还是刚刚起步，这个工具都会将您的创作提升到新的高度！

✨ 主要特点

  • 利用 Flux1-dev 和 Flux1-schnell 模型进行高质量的碱基生成

  • 集成 ComfyUI-OllamaGemini 以进行人工智能驱动的文本生成和分析

  • 包含一体式节点，提供多种样式选择

  • 包括用于高分辨率输出的终极升级器

  • 允许动态混合多个参考图像

🔑 所需模型和节点

基本型号：

（fp8 完整版 - 无需关心剪辑或 vae）

https://civitai.com/models/629858?modelVersionId=704188

自定义节点：

  • ComfyUI-OllamaGemini

  • 多合一式节点

  • 终极升级节点

🛠️ 如何使用

  1. 安装所需的模型和自定义节点（上面的链接）

  2. 将工作流程加载到 ComfyUI 中

  3. 输入风格、深度和照明的参考图像

  4. 从 All-IN-ONE 样式节点中选择其他样式

  5. 生成您独特的 AI 艺术作品

  6. 高档的令人惊叹的高分辨率结果

🎯 非常适合

  • 艺术家希望无缝融合多种风格

  • 希望精细控制图像氛围和深度的创作者

  • 任何有兴趣突破人工智能生成艺术界限的人

🎨 Advanced AI Art Remix Workflow for ComfyUI

Unlock new realms of creative possibilities with this advanced ComfyUI workflow!

📌 Overview

This cutting-edge ComfyUI workflow allows you to remix and blend various art styles, control depth and lighting, and emulate artist techniques using state-of-the-art AI models. It combines the power of Flux models with intelligent prompt generation and extensive style libraries for unparalleled creative flexibility. Whether you're a seasoned AI artist or just starting out, this tool will elevate your creations to new heights!

✨ Key Features

  • Utilizes Flux1-dev and Flux1-schnell models for high-quality base generation

  • Integrates ComfyUI-OllamaGemini for AI-powered text generation and analysis

  • Incorporates All-IN-ONE-style node for vast style options

  • Includes ultimate upscaler for high-resolution outputs

  • Allows for dynamic mixing of multiple reference images

🔑 Required Models and Nodes

Base Models:

(fp8 full version - no need to care about clips nor vae)

https://civitai.com/models/629858?modelVersionId=704188

Custom Nodes:

  • ComfyUI-OllamaGemini

  • All-IN-ONE-style node

  • Ultimate Upscaler node

🛠️ How to Use

  1. Install required models and custom nodes (links above)

  2. Load the workflow into ComfyUI

  3. Input reference images for style, depth, and lighting

  4. Choose additional styles from All-IN-ONE-style node

  5. Generate your unique AI artwork

  6. Upscale for stunning high-res results

🎯 Perfect for

  • Artists looking to blend multiple styles seamlessly

  • Creators wanting fine control over image atmosphere and depth

  • Anyone interested in pushing the boundaries of AI-generated art
